children: Zscaler, Inc. reported full-year 2026 revenue of $3.35B, up 25% from $2.67B a year earlier, while the company posted a net loss of $63.2M and diluted loss per share of $(0.39) for the year.
Revenue was $3,352.5M for FY 2026, up from $2,673.1M in FY 2025; YoY change 25%.
Net income: net loss $63.2M for FY 2026, compared with net loss $41.5M in FY 2025 (worsened loss).
Diluted EPS was $(0.39) for FY 2026, compared with $(0.27) in FY 2025 (more negative YoY).
Revenue growth of 25% in FY26 was driven by user expansion and upsells to existing customers.
Customer base reached roughly 11,000, including more than 40% of the Forbes Global 2000, as the company expanded its global footprint.
Management continued investing in direct sales, channel partners, global systems integrators and cloud marketplaces to accelerate new customer acquisition.
Zscaler expanded its cloud-native zero trust platform and increased R&D and cloud operations capacity to support AI, users and workloads.
Significant capital and platform investments were funded by strong operating cash flow and advance billings, reflecting cash-backed growth investments.
